calls.title: Growthbook <> Rappi - Demo
calls.summary: In a demo call, GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates) addressed Rappi’s pain points of low Statsig adoption, metric fragmentation, and single points of failure, presenting features like metrics governance, Snowflake-native analysis, AI-powered experimentation, and a Statsig migration tool. Key participants included Jaime Sempertegui (Rappi’s advanced statistics lead) and the GrowthBook team. Next steps: Jaime will discuss internally with his team, and a follow-up check-in is scheduled for the following Tuesday.
